task_reconstruction.summary: Help the ICM understand how economic development can proceed without compromising future resource use.
Build a two-part sustainability metric, then a 20-year Zambia plan, then evaluate the plan with that metric.

contributions.summary: An ecological index that flips a GWP-weighted pollution sum and nonrenewable energy onto [0, 1].
A development index that weights inequality-adjusted income more than education.
A wealth-population cellular automaton used to place aid.
A particle-swarm allocation after three other optimizers are rejected.

dependency_graph.summary: The tradeoff plot uses D_i and E_i.
The function map asks what to fund after the automaton says where.
Sustainability S weights D_i and E_i by alpha.

assumptions.summary: Only air pollution matters for a developing country, by Kuznet's Curve.
Zambia follows worldwide trends from its current seed.
Funding is discrete and its effect is deterministic.
Industry size does not change without ICM funding, and funding is not squandered.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: GWP values are the IPCC 2013 100-year figures for six named pollutants.
Norm uses worldwide maxima and minima, the HDI procedure.
Appendix fits come from Worldbank and WHO linearized plots.
